Professor Jane M. Carter  
Department of Computer Science  
University of Cambridge  
Cambridge, UK  
[jane.carter@cam.ac.uk]  
October 5, 2023  

Femi Akinlade’s role as a QA/Test Engineer at InnovateTech Consulting requires a balance of precision and adaptability, both of which he consistently delivers. During our occasional collaborations, I observed his ability to methodically dissect complex systems, identifying edge cases that others overlook. In a recent project involving a client’s legacy infrastructure, Femi’s structured approach to manual testing uncovered a critical race condition that could have compromised data integrity. His documentation of the issue, complete with repro steps and impact analysis, enabled the development team to resolve it before deployment, averting a potential $200K loss. This incident underscores his technical rigor and attention to detail.  

Beyond technical prowess, Femi’s soft skills are equally compelling. He thrives in collaborative environments, often acting as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders. During a high-stakes audit, his clear communication of test results to executives ensured alignment on priorities, while his patience in mentoring junior team members fostered a culture of shared accountability.  

Femi’s contributions extend beyond his individual performance. He spearheaded a process improvement initiative that streamlined defect tracking, reducing resolution time by 35% across three client projects. His work ethic is marked by consistency—whether debugging late-night issues or refining test scenarios, he approaches every task with equal dedication.  

I wholeheartedly recommend Femi for any role requiring analytical depth and interpersonal clarity. His ability to merge technical expertise with collaborative leadership makes him a valuable asset. Please feel free to contact me for further details.
